info.title: Open Congress API
info.description: A modern REST API for Philippine Congress data powered by Neo4j graph database.

schema.description: Filter by year (matches if within start_year and end_year)
Filter by document subtype (HB or SB)
Filter by position: senator or representative
Sort field: first_name, middle_name, last_name, name_suffix
Include congresses served via MEMBER_OF and BELONGS_TO relationships
Search query for names and aliases
Filter by position: senator or representative
Filter by congress number or 'all' (default: all)
Filter by author person ID (comma-separated for multiple)
Search in title, abstract, or author names
Search query for title, abstract, or author names
Filter by congress number, ULID, or 'all' (default: all)
Filter by scope: national, local, both, any (default: any)
Filter by document type: hb, sb, any (default: any)
Sort field: date_filed, congress, bill_number, title, scope
